caption: The drawing depicts a relief sculpture rendered in shades of gray, resembling pencil or charcoal on a plain off-white background. The composition features a carved human figure seated in profile facing left, with detailed patterns on its garment. The head of the figure is rounded and lacks distinct facial features. The figure is holding or is adjacent to a large, vertically-oriented plant with prominent leaves, a bulbous flower bud, and a textured surface. The backdrop and surrounding areas include textured and patterned surfaces that suggest architectural or ornamental elements. The entire relief is framed within a rectangular block with jagged and uneven edges, and the details are intricate, emphasizing the contours and surface variations of the carved stone. Near the bottom right of the drawing, the artist’s signature “URSULA LEDERBOSE” appears in small black lettering.
title: Small Stone Fountain
